surface: Native test process / CUA credential handling
auth_mode: member acceptance setup; infrastructure failure before identity verification
title: Native app re-selection emits unmasked reviewer credentials in accessibility output
reproduction: Use a synthetic or disposable credential in a controlled native test session; never use a real credential for reproduction.
While handling a protected Store UI, trigger native app re-selection/refresh and inspect whether accessibility output is emitted before redaction.
Stop immediately if any secret appears; do not retain the output, retry authentication, or use a real account.
expected: Native app selection must not emit secret-bearing accessibility output before the caller can redact it; sensitive fields must be excluded at the capture boundary.
actual: During member test setup, native app re-selection automatically emitted an accessibility tree containing unmasked Store reviewer credentials before redaction could run. The login attempt was rejected and no member identity or Notes operation was confirmed.
severity: S1: native test tooling exposed an unmasked Store reviewer credential in accessibility output
priority: P0: credential remediation and safe native capture repair are urgent
verification_status: Open remediation. The password was re-hidden, clipboard overwritten with whitespace, and private CUA credential bindings cleared. No credential value is present in repository evidence. Parent owns credential remediation; completion is pending. Any retest must use synthetic or disposable credentials. The Notes member lane remains unverified, and this is not a Notes product defect verdict.
containment: Credential fields were hidden again; clipboard was overwritten with whitespace; private CUA credential bindings were cleared. No credential retry, reset, or account mutation followed. No credential value is retained in repository evidence.
pending_step: Parent-owned remediation of the exposed reviewer credential and repair of native accessibility capture so sensitive fields are excluded before output; then verify only with synthetic/disposable data.

transition_history.reason: Native app re-selection emitted unmasked credential content in accessibility output during member test setup.

separate_credential_loading_incident: 2026-10-08: a worker evaluated a dotenv file as shell and emitted an unclassified fragment into local task tool output, not confirmed to be an authentication value. Failed parse staged/persisted no secret; parsing replaced by selecting named variables with a dotenv parser. No fragment retained in shared evidence, no tool-history erasure claimed, no isolated credential rotation. This is separate from original accessibility-tree failure and does not close or reproduce that exact gate.
